contract.description: Approve verification commands, or report the latest result per command.

review.description: Record a review run, findings, dispositions and resolutions; render the report text.

task.description: Start, mark, verify or list tasks, and gate the ticket on readiness.

ticket.description: Create, validate, read or update a ticket's context lines; routes models by scope.

snapshot.description: Return the ticket's objective state as JSON and Markdown text for baton-pass to write.

close.description: List live work that blocks closing, or close the ticket and return the archive text.

investigation.description: Open an investigation, append ledger entries, or render the ledger or its knowns.

crashout.description: Journal a crashout, or report recurring patterns.
